flags.sourceSentence: At the end of the initial term, and at the end of each term thereafter, your membership renews automatically for a further twelve (12) month term at the then-current rate.
flags.consequence: The agreement renews automatically for successive 12-month terms at the then-current rate without a fresh signature, and a suspended, frozen or medically held membership still renews on the original schedule.

flags.sourceSentence: Notice delivered after that day takes effect at the end of the term that follows, and the dues for the intervening term remain payable in full.
flags.consequence: Missing the 3-day cancellation window commits the signer to a further full 12-month term at the then-current rate, and a late notice only takes effect after the term after that, with dues for the intervening term payable in full.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may amend the Club Rules, the Schedule of Fees, the hours of operation, the class timetable and the terms of this Agreement at any time by posting the amended version at the club or on the Meridian website, and the amended version applies to you from the date it is posted.
flags.consequence: Meridian can change the Club Rules, the fee schedule, hours, the timetable and the terms of this agreement at any time by posting the amended version, and the changes apply from the date posted, with continued use treated as acceptance — so fees and obligations the signer agreed to can be replaced without their signature.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian’s total liability to you for any claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or your use of any facility — whether the claim is framed in contract, in negligence or otherwise — will not exceed the total dues and fees you paid to Meridian in the twelve (12) months immediately before the event giving rise to the claim.
flags.consequence: Meridian's total liability for any claim — including negligence — is capped at the dues and fees paid in the prior 12 months, and it is not liable for lost income, lost business opportunity, or loss of or damage to personal property, including property left in a locker.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify, defend and hold harmless Meridian and its ofﬁcers, employees, instructors and contractors against any claim, demand, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable legal fees, that is brought by a third party and arises out of your use of the facilities, your conduct on club premises, the conduct of a guest you bring, or any service you provide to another member.
flags.consequence: The signer must cover Meridian's legal fees and any third-party claim arising from their use of the facilities, their conduct, their guest's conduct, or any service they provide to another member, and cannot settle without Meridian's written consent, with Meridian choosing the lawyer.

flags.sourceSentence: For twelve (12) months after your Program candidacy ends for any reason, you will not teach, coach or deliver group ﬁtness instruction or personal training, whether as an employee, as a contractor or on your own account, at any facility within ﬁfteen (15) miles of a Meridian location at which you taught or trained.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after the signer's Program candidacy ends for any reason, they cannot teach, coach or deliver fitness instruction or personal training, as employee, contractor or on their own account, at any facility within 15 miles of a Meridian location where they taught or trained, and cannot solicit Meridian members or candidates for outside instruction.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute, claim or controversy between you and Meridian arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or the Program will be resolved by ﬁnal and binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer arbitration rules, and you and Meridian each waive any right to a trial by jury and any right to bring or participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer waives the right to a jury trial and to bring or participate in class, collective or representative actions, and must resolve disputes in individual binding arbitration; the opt-out window closes 30 days after acceptance.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may adjust dues once in any twelve (12) month period by the greater of six percent (6%)  or the increase in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers over the preceding twelve months, on thirty (30) days notice to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: Meridian can raise dues once in any 12-month period by the greater of 6% or CPI on 30 days' email notice, so the monthly amount is not fixed for the term.

flags.sourceSentence: Dues not received within ten (10) days of the draw date incur the late charge set out in the Schedule of Fees then in effect, which is posted at the Member Services desk and on the Meridian website and forms part of this Agreement.
flags.consequence: Late charges, returned-payment charges, keycard replacement charges and account reinstatement charges are set in a Schedule of Fees kept at the desk and online rather than in the agreement, so the amounts are not visible in the document the signer is given, and the schedule can be amended by posting.

flags.sourceSentence: Program enrolment renews on each anniversary of your Program start date at the then-current tuition.
flags.consequence: Program tuition renews automatically each anniversary at the then-current tuition, and the signer must give written notice at least 90 days before the anniversary to stop it; missing the window means another year of tuition is charged.

flags.sourceSentence: Access is by keycard or through the application, and you are responsible for every entry made with your keycard or your account.
flags.consequence: The signer is responsible for every entry made with their keycard or account, so any unauthorised or mistaken use of their card or account is billed or held against them.

flags.sourceSentence: You authorise Meridian to draw all dues, tuition and charges from the payment method on your account until this Agreement has ended and your balance is nil.
flags.consequence: The signer authorises Meridian to keep drawing all dues, tuition and charges from their payment method until the agreement has ended and the balance is nil, so the payment mandate outlasts any single billing period.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Plot Holder gives notice, no refund is due, and the Plot Holder may harvest whatever is ready before the notice period runs out.
flags.consequence: If the plot holder ends the licence early, they forfeit the whole remaining season's fee with no refund, even for months they will not use the plot.

flags.sourceSentence: Anything left after 15 December becomes the Association’s to keep or to clear.
flags.consequence: Any canes, netting, frames or other belongings still on the plot after 15 December 2027 are permanently lost to the Association, which may keep or dispose of them.

flags.sourceSentence: On an annual plan the deadline to cancel is the day that falls thirty (30) days before the anniversary of the date you first subscribed, and where no cancellation is received by that day the term extends by a further twelve (12) months at the annual fee then in effect.
flags.consequence: On an annual plan, missing the cancellation deadline commits the signer to another full twelve months at whatever the annual fee is at that time, with no fresh signature.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Northwind harmless from any claim brought by a third party that relates to content you uploaded, exported or published through the service, including a claim that the content infringes a copyright, a trade mark or a right of privacy, and you will pay our reasonable legal costs of defending such a claim.
flags.consequence: The signer must pay Northwind's reasonable legal costs and cover any third-party claim connected to content they uploaded, exported or published — an obligation that is open-ended and not capped by the liability limit in Section 5.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between you and Northwind arising out of these terms or out of your use of the service will be settled by binding arbitration before a single arbitrator under the consumer rules of a recognised arbitration body, and you agree to bring any claim only in your individual capacity and not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, collective or representative proceeding.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action against Northwind, and any dispute — including over lost work or a failed export — must go through individual binding arbitration with a final award, leaving only small-claims court as an alternative.

flags.sourceSentence: We may revise the fee for any plan, and a revised fee applies to you from the start of the first Billing Period that begins more than thirty (30) days after we send notice of the revision to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: The signer's price can be raised unilaterally, with the new fee taking effect after 30 days' notice to their email, and the only way out is cancelling before the new Billing Period starts.

flags.sourceSentence: Where a payment is not collected on its due date, interest accrues on the unpaid amount at one and one half percent (1.5%) per month from the due date until payment is received, and an account suspended for non-payment is subject to the reactivation charge published in the Fee Schedule on the Northwind support site.
flags.consequence: A missed or failed payment accrues interest at 1.5% per month (about 18% a year) on the unpaid amount, and getting a suspended account back requires paying a reactivation charge whose amount is set in a Fee Schedule the signer must find on the company's support site.

flags.sourceSentence: We may amend these terms, the pricing page and the Fee Schedule at any time, an amended version takes effect when we post it at northwindstudio.example/terms, and your continued use of the service after it is posted is your acceptance of the amended version.
flags.consequence: The terms, pricing and Fee Schedule can be changed at any time by posting to a webpage, and simply continuing to use the service counts as accepting the changes — including changes that add costs or remove rights.

flags.sourceSentence: Where availability in a calendar month falls below that figure, your remedy is the service credit set out in the Service Credit Policy and nothing further.
flags.consequence: If the service underperforms, the signer's only remedy is the service credit described in a separate Service Credit Policy — no refund of the fees paid and no other claim for the downtime.

flags.sourceSentence: Northwind’s aggregate liability to you for every claim relating to the service, whether framed in contract, in tort, in warranty or otherwise — and including any claim arising from lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — will not exceed the amount you actually paid us under Section 2 for the Billing Period in which the claim arose.
flags.consequence: Northwind's total liability for everything — including lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — is limited to the amount the signer paid for the single Billing Period in which the claim arose, which could be one month's fee.

flags.sourceSentence: Your subscription continues from one Billing Period into the next without further action by either of us, and we bill the plan fee then in effect on the first day of each new Billing Period.
flags.consequence: The subscription rolls over automatically into each new Billing Period without any fresh action, and the signer must actively cancel by the day before the period ends (monthly) or 30 days before the anniversary (annual) to stop it.

flags.sourceSentence: A cancellation made on or after the first day of a Billing Period takes effect at the end of that Billing Period, and the fee already collected for it is not refunded.
flags.consequence: If the signer cancels on or after the first day of a Billing Period, the fee already collected for that whole period is kept, so they pay for up to a full month (or year) they may not use.

flags.sourceSentence: For a period of twelve (12) months following the last day of your employment, whether that employment ends at your choice or at ours, you will not provide services that are the same as or substantially similar to those you provided to Ardent, whether as an employee, a consultant, a contractor, an adviser or a principal, to any business that develops, manufactures or sells a product within the Restricted Field as that term is defined in Exhibit B to this letter.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after leaving, the signer cannot work in a similar role for any business in the 'Restricted Field' — as an employee, contractor, consultant, adviser or principal — and cannot approach Ardent customers, distributors, contract manufacturers or solicit colleagues. The scope of 'Restricted Field' and the geographic reach are in Exhibit B, which was not provided, so the signer cannot yet see how much of their future employment this blocks.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify Ardent and hold it harmless against any claim, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable attorney fees, that arises out of a breach by you of Section 4 or Section 5 of this letter, or out of a claim by a former employer that your employment with Ardent breaches an obligation you owe to them.
flags.consequence: The signer must personally pay Ardent's claims, losses and attorney fees arising from a breach of the confidentiality or non-compete sections, and also for a claim by a former employer that this job breaches an obligation to them — an open-ended financial exposure the signer does not control.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Ardent each agree that any claim arising out of or relating to your employment, its terms, or its end, including any statutory claim, will be resolved by final and binding arbitration administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised arbitration provider, on an individual basis only, and each of us waives any right to a jury trial and any right to participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to take any employment-related claim — including statutory claims — to a jury or as part of a class or collective action; every dispute must go through individual binding arbitration.

flags.sourceSentence: If you resign or are terminated for cause within twelve (12) months of your start date, the full signing payment becomes repayable within thirty days of your last working day.
flags.consequence: The signer must repay the entire $15,000 signing payment within 30 days of their last working day if they resign or are fired for cause within the first 12 months — even if they leave for a better job or the role proves unsuitable.

flags.sourceSentence: Ardent may introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, handbook provision, benefit plan or term of employment described in this letter at any time and without your agreement, and the version in force on the Ardent intranet governs from the date it is published there.
flags.consequence: The company can change or withdraw any policy, benefit or term described in the offer at any time without the signer's agreement, so the benefits and terms as written are not locked in for as long as the signer works there.

flags.sourceSentence: On or before your start date you will sign the Employee Confidential Information and Invention Assignment Agreement enclosed with this letter.
flags.consequence: The signer must sign a separate Confidential Information and Invention Assignment Agreement before starting, and its obligations continue after employment ends; the text of that agreement is not in this document, so its terms cannot be reviewed here.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator's total liability to the Occupant for any loss of or damage to stored property, however caused, including loss or damage caused by the Operator's own negligence, is limited to five thousand dollars ($5,000) unless the Occupant has declared a higher value on the Unit Schedule and paid the corresponding value protection fee.
flags.consequence: The occupant must keep insurance on the stored property for its full value and produce evidence on request; without it, the occupant bears all risk of loss, and even with it, the Operator's liability for loss or damage — including damage caused by the Operator's own negligence — is capped at $5,000 unless the occupant declared a higher value and paid a value protection fee.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant will indemnify, defend and hold the Operator harmless from every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense, including reasonable attorney fees, brought by any person and arising out of the Occupant's use of the unit or the premises, the property stored in the unit, or the acts of anyone the Occupant allows on to the premises.
flags.consequence: The occupant must indemnify, defend and hold the Operator harmless from every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense, including attorney fees, arising from the occupant's use of the unit or premises, the stored property, or the acts of anyone the occupant allows on site — an open-ended obligation with no dollar cap that the occupant pays even if the claim is disputed.

flags.sourceSentence: Where rent or any charge is unpaid, the Operator has a lien on all property stored in the unit and may deny the Occupant access, overlock the unit, and after the notice period the law requires, sell the contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed.
flags.consequence: If rent or any charge is unpaid, the lease says the Operator has a lien on everything in the unit, can deny the occupant access and overlock the unit, and after the notice period the law requires can sell the contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed — so a small unpaid charge could ultimately cost the occupant the entire contents of the unit.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent not received by the sixth day of the month incurs the late charge shown in the Schedule of Charges posted in the ofﬁce and on the Harbour Road website, and each further notice the Operator is required to send about an unpaid balance incurs the administration charge shown in the same schedule.
flags.consequence: The late charge and per-notice administration charges are not stated in the agreement itself; they sit in a Schedule of Charges the occupant must find in the office or on a website, so the occupant is agreeing to amounts they cannot see in this document, and each notice about an unpaid balance adds another charge.

flags.sourceSentence: Gate hours, the rules posted in the office, and the terms of this Agreement may be changed by the Operator on notice posted at the facility and sent to the Occupant's last known email address, and the changed version applies to the Occupant from the first day of the month after it is posted.
flags.consequence: The Operator can change the rules, gate hours, and the terms of the agreement itself by posting notice at the facility and emailing the occupant's last known address, with the changes binding from the first day of the following month — so terms the occupant agreed to can be replaced unilaterally, and a stale email address means changes may never actually reach them.

flags.sourceSentence: After the initial term this Agreement continues on a month to month basis, each month renewing on the first day of the month without notice from either party, until it is ended as Section 8 describes.
flags.consequence: The agreement renews itself month to month without any fresh signature, so it will not end on its own; the occupant must give written notice at least ten days before the end of a month to stop it, and rent for the month of move-out is not refunded.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator may end this Agreement on thirty days written notice.
flags.consequence: The Operator can end the agreement on thirty days' written notice, requiring the occupant to remove all property and vacate on the Operator's timeline.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a twelve month promotional plan renews for a further twelve month term at the end of the term then running, at the standard rate for the plan rather than at the promotional rate, unless you tell us to stop the renewal before the last day of the current term.
flags.consequence: A twelve-month promotional plan renews automatically for another twelve-month term at the standard rate rather than the promotional rate, so the signer could pay a higher rate for a full year unless they cancel the renewal before the last day of the current term.

flags.sourceSentence: Cancelling a promotional plan before the end of its term does not cancel a device instalment plan, and the unpaid instalment balance becomes due in full on your next bill.
flags.consequence: Cancelling a promotional service plan before its term ends makes the entire unpaid device instalment balance due immediately on the next bill, which could be a large lump-sum charge.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Cascade agree that any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, the service or any device will be resolved by individual binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer rules, and both of us give up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action, so serious disputes must be pursued as individual arbitration only.

flags.sourceSentence: Your bill includes a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge, neither of which is a tax or a charge required by any government, and Cascade may introduce, increase or remove either charge on notice given with the bill in which the change ﬁrst appears.
flags.consequence: The bill includes a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge that are not government-required, and Cascade can introduce, increase or remove either charge on notice given with the bill in which the change first appears, so these recurring costs can rise with only bill-level notice.

flags.sourceSentence: An amount not paid by the due date shown on the bill incurs a late payment charge of the greater of five dollars ($5.00) or one and one half percent of the unpaid balance, applied each bill period until the balance is paid, and a restored line incurs the restoral charge shown in the Rate and Charge Guide.
flags.consequence: An unpaid balance incurs a late charge of the greater of $5.00 or 1.5% of the unpaid balance applied each bill period until paid, so the charge compounds on a continuing overdue balance, and restoring a suspended line adds a restoral charge set in the Rate and Charge Guide, which was not supplied.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade may change any term of this Agreement, any charge, and any feature of your rate plan, and the change takes effect on the date stated in the notice we give you, which may be given on a bill, by message to your device, or by email.
flags.consequence: Cascade can change any term, charge or rate-plan feature on notice (which may be given on a bill, by device message, or by email), and continued use after the effective date accepts the change, so the signer could face new or higher charges without fresh consent; the only exit without an early termination charge is cancelling within thirty days of a materially higher recurring charge.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade’s entire liability to you for any claim relating to the service, a device, or this Agreement, whether the claim is made in contract, in negligence, in warranty or under any statute, is limited to the service charges applied to the affected line during the bill period in which the claim arose, and Cascade is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or any indirect or consequential loss.
flags.consequence: Cascade's total liability for any claim is capped at one bill period's service charges on the affected line, and it is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or indirect or consequential loss, so a serious service failure could leave the signer with minimal recovery.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Cascade harmless from any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal fees, arising out of your use of the service, out of anything sent from or stored on your device, out of the use of your line by anyone you allow to use it, and out of any charge incurred on your account.
flags.consequence: The signer must cover Cascade's claims, losses and expenses, including reasonable legal fees, arising from use of the service, content sent or stored on the device, use of the line by anyone the signer allows, and any charge incurred on the account, which is open-ended exposure.

flags.sourceSentence: Service on a monthly plan has no fixed term and continues from bill period to bill period until cancelled.
flags.consequence: On a monthly plan the service continues from bill period to bill period until cancelled and does not end on its own, so the signer keeps being billed unless they actively cancel by calling or through the account portal.

flags.sourceSentence: Charges accrue to the end of the bill period in which you cancel, and a part bill period is not prorated.
flags.consequence: Charges accrue to the end of the bill period in which the signer cancels and the final part bill period is not prorated, so the signer pays for days of service they will not use after cancelling.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may end the Programme early for any reason on one week written notice.
flags.consequence: The Firm can end the twelve-week Programme at any point for any reason on only one week's notice, so the Analyst could lose roughly eleven weeks of stipend and the programme experience with no compensation.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may amend the Programme Handbook, the assessment structure, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement at any time by issuing a revised version to the Analyst by email, and the revised version applies from the date of that email.
flags.consequence: The Firm can change the Handbook, the assessments, the teaching schedule and even the terms of this Agreement itself at any time by email, and the change takes effect immediately from the date of the email, so terms the Analyst agreed to can be replaced without their consent.

flags.sourceSentence: For six (6) months after the Programme ends, the Analyst will not accept an engagement, whether paid or unpaid and whether as an employee, a contractor or an intern, with any firm on the Restricted List issued to the Analyst in week one of the Programme, and will not approach any client of the Firm whose file the Analyst worked on.
flags.consequence: For six months after the Programme, the Analyst cannot take any engagement, paid or unpaid, with any firm on a Restricted List they may not fully know in advance (it is confidential and can be reissued), which could block a significant share of entry-level job options in the field.

flags.sourceSentence: The Analyst will indemnify the Firm and hold it harmless against any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal costs, arising out of a breach by the Analyst of Section 4 or Section 5, or out of anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or a client of the Firm.
flags.consequence: The Analyst must repay the Firm for any claim, loss or expense, including legal costs, arising from breaching confidentiality, the post-programme restrictions, or anything they publish about the Firm or its clients — an open-ended amount with no cap, triggered even by unpaid or casual publications.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between the Analyst and the Firm arising out of the Programme or out of this Agreement will be resolved by final and binding arbitration on an individual basis, administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised provider, and the Analyst gives up any right to a jury trial and any right to bring or join a class or collective action.
flags.consequence: The Analyst gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class or collective action, so any dispute — including over unpaid stipend or the indemnity — must be pursued as an individual arbitration, removing the practical ability to pool small claims with other analysts.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Analyst takes the optional housing advance, it is repaid in six equal instalments deducted from the stipend, and any instalment not recovered within ten (10) days of its due date carries the late charge set out in the Programme Handbook until it is repaid in full.
flags.consequence: A late housing-advance instalment accrues a late charge, set in the Programme Handbook the Analyst has not been given, that continues to grow until the advance is repaid in full — an amount the signer cannot see before signing.

flags.sourceSentence: This obligation has no end date.
flags.consequence: The confidentiality obligation never expires, so the Analyst is exposed to the indemnity in Section 6 for any breach of it for the rest of their life, with no time limit on that financial exposure.

flags.sourceSentence: An item not returned within five working days is charged at the replacement cost shown in the Programme Handbook.
flags.consequence: Equipment not returned within five working days is charged at the replacement cost listed in the Programme Handbook, a document the signer has not been given, so the amount is unknown at signing.
